import re
# Each alternative has its own sign prefix
pattern = r'[-+]?\d{1,3}(?:[,_]\d{3})*\.\d+|[-+]?\d+\.\d*|[-+]?.?\d+'
tests = ['-.121', '.121', '-12.1', '12.0', '+.5', '1_000.5']
for t in tests:
    m = re.match(pattern + '$', t)
    print(f'{t!r}: {\"match: \" + m.group() if m else \"no match\"}')
"
